projects.description: TimeCocoon · 时间茧 is a local-first personal work system. You state a goal, approve a plan, and watch an agent runtime stream the work into real artifacts. This repository is the scaffold for that system: strict tooling from the first commit, and one sample module — projects, plus a live run — that later features should copy.
